ops.title: repo add --local-only on a repo with an origin remote writes a state entry validateState rejects — next load wedges the whole CLI
ops.description:
Live defect on v0.27.4 main, found while diagnosing the yasyf-home state migration: `repo add --local-only` on a repo WITH an origin remote writes a propagating `repos` entry carrying `local_only:true` — internal/cli/repo.go:121-132 only clears `origin` in the ErrNoOrigin branch, while AddRepo routes on `Origin == ""`, so the entry lands in the propagating map with the flag set. `validateState` (internal/state/state.go:334-338) rejects exactly that shape (`entry.Value.LocalOnly` clause) on EVERY subsequent state load, so the very next command wedges the entire CLI with `invalid propagating repo entry`.

Field evidence: yasyf-home's state carried `/Users/yasyf/.cache/toctou-e2e-origin.git` (tombstoned, local_only:true, in `repos`) — this bug is the likely origin. Remediation for wedged states exists: the audit/migration pair (/tmp/reposync-audit.jq + /tmp/reposync-repair.sh from the 2026-07-26 stabilization work; recipe recorded on daemonkit cc-notes task fc39f885) — keeps tombstones with original stamps (anti-resurrection is load-bearing per cregistry.Compact), forces local_only:false only on ABSENT entries, refuses on present ones.

Related: the shared synckit hostregistry ErrStateSchema "manually recreate exact schema v1 state" message with no repair path/tooling is a separate synckit bug (being filed there).

ops.text: repo add --local-only routes the entry to local_repos (or clears origin) so validateState accepts the result
regression test covers add --local-only on a repo that has an origin remote
existing wedged states are diagnosable: error names the offending entry and the audit/migration remedy
